details.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$lock='.git/index.lock'; Write-Output '---LOCK---'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $lock){Get-Item -LiteralPath $lock | Select-Object FullName,Length,CreationTime,LastWriteTime | Format-List}else{Write-Output 'NO_INDEX_LOCK'}; Write-Output '---GIT_PROCESSES---'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^git(\.exe)?$' -or $_.CommandLine -match 'git(\.exe)?\s' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,ParentProcessId,CommandLine | Format-List"
